description: Velero (Kubernetes backup and restore): server health, backup locations, schedules, backups, restores, snapshots, node agent and repository maintenance. Metrics of the Velero server and node agent scraped through the PodMonitor of the prometheus component.

panels.title: Velero server
panels.description: Velero server pods (not the node agent) that Prometheus scrapes successfully.

panels.title: Backup locations unavailable
panels.description: Locations whose last validation by Velero failed. Backups into them fail.

panels.title: Schedules failing
panels.description: Schedules whose most recent backup did not complete successfully. Manual backups are not counted.

panels.title: Schedules overdue
panels.description: Schedules without a successful backup for more than twice their expected interval. Manual backups are not counted.

panels.title: Existing backups
panels.description: Number of Backup objects currently known to Velero (all schedules, manual ones, not yet expired).

panels.title: Existing restores
panels.description: Number of Restore objects currently known to Velero.

panels.title: Backup success ratio
panels.description: Successful backups of all attempts in the selected time range.

panels.title: Backups attempted
panels.description: Backups started in the selected time range.

panels.title: Backups failed
panels.description: Failed backups in the selected time range, partial failures not included.

panels.title: Backups partially failed
panels.description: Backups that completed but with errors in the selected time range.

panels.title: Total backup size
panels.description: Sum of the size of the last backup of each selected schedule (tarball only, without volume data).

panels.title: Restores attempted
panels.description: Restores started in the selected time range.

panels.title: Backup location availability
panels.description: Velero validates every BackupStorageLocation periodically. 1 = available, 0 = unavailable.

panels.title: Backup locations
panels.description: Current status of each location.

panels.title: Schedules
panels.description: One line per schedule, manual backups (not created by a schedule) are listed as (manual): status of the last backup, age of the last successful backup, expected interval and results of the last backup. Overdue = last success older than twice the expected interval.

panels.title: Status of the last backup
panels.description: 1 = last backup of the schedule succeeded, 0 = it failed.

panels.title: Time since last successful backup
panels.description: Age of the newest successful backup per schedule. Compare with the expected interval below.

panels.title: Backups by result
panels.description: Backups per result within each interval of the graph.

panels.title: Backups by schedule
panels.description: Backup attempts and failures per schedule within each interval.

panels.title: Backup duration
panels.description: Percentiles of the time backups take, across the selected schedules. The buckets range from 1 minute to 4 hours, so the values are coarse.

panels.title: Average backup duration per schedule
panels.description: Mean duration of backups finished within the interval.

panels.title: Backup size per schedule
panels.description: Size of the last backup (tarball with the Kubernetes resources, without volume data).

panels.title: Items per backup
panels.description: Number of Kubernetes resources in the last backup, and the errors that occurred while backing them up.

panels.title: Existing backups
panels.description: Backup objects in the cluster. Falls when backups expire (ttl) or are deleted.

panels.title: Backup deletions
panels.description: Deletions of expired or manually removed backups per interval. Failed deletions leave data in the backup location.

panels.title: Restores by result
panels.description: Restores per result within each interval.

panels.title: Existing restores
panels.description: Restore objects in the cluster.

panels.title: Volume snapshots
panels.description: Snapshots created through a volume snapshotter plugin (not CSI, not file-system backup).

panels.title: CSI snapshots
panels.description: Snapshots created through CSI (volumeMethod csiSnapshot). Empty if CSI is not enabled.

panels.title: Pod volume backups queue
panels.description: Backups of pod volumes (file-system backup) the node agent picked up (enqueued) and started processing (dequeued). A growing difference means the agent is behind.

panels.title: Pod volume operation duration
panels.description: Percentiles of the time the node agent needs to back up or restore a pod volume, per operation.

panels.title: Data uploads (CSI data movement)
panels.description: Snapshot data uploaded to the backup location by the node agent (csiSnapshotMoveData).

panels.title: Data downloads (restore of CSI data)
panels.description: Snapshot data downloaded from the backup location during a restore.

panels.title: Maintenance jobs
panels.description: Kopia repository maintenance jobs per repository. Failed maintenance lets the backup location grow.

panels.title: Maintenance duration
panels.description: Average duration of maintenance jobs per repository.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU of the Velero server and node agent pods.

panels.title: Memory usage
panels.description: Working set of the Velero server and node agent pods. The node agent grows with the size of the volumes it backs up.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Container restarts in the selected range. OOM kills of the node agent show up here.

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the Velero server and node agent pods (1 = up).
